 DIII field hockey: 2026 selection show

 The Division III field hockey committee announced the field of 28 teams that will compete in the 2026 Division III field hockey championship. Click or tap here for the press release.
 Live streams: Watch every DIII field hockey match here 
 Here is everything you need to know for the 2026 DIII field hockey championship:
 2026 DIII field hockey championship bracket
 Click or tap here for the interactive bracket. 
  2026 DIII field hockey championship schedule
 All times listed in ET. 
 First round : Wednesday, Nov. 11 | Live on NCAA.com 
 ​​​​​ 1 p.m. | Rowan vs. Rhodes 
 3 p.m. | Babson vs. Union (New York) 
 3 p.m. | Salisbury vs. Penn State Harrisburg 
 4 p.m. | Hamilton vs. Southern Maine 
 4 p.m. | Johns Hopkins vs. Denison 
 4 p.m. | Stevenson vs. Colby-Sawyer 
 4 p.m. | Ursinus vs. Stevens 
 4 p.m. | Wesleyan (Connecticut) vs. SUNY Geneseo 
 4 p.m. | York (Pennsylvania) vs. Washington & Lee 
 6 p.m. | Amherst vs. Endicott 
 6 p.m. | Swarthmore vs. Scranton 
 6 p.m. | Williams vs. Bridgewater State 
 Second round:  Saturday, Nov. 14 | Live on NCAA.com 
 Third round : Sunday, Nov. 15 | Live on NCAA.com 
 Semifinals : 11 a.m. or 2:30 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 20 | Live on NCAA.com 
 National championship : 12 p.m. on Sunday, Nov. 22 | Live on NCAA.com
